name: Shevara
description: An elf warrior and scout of the Rotrue clan who counts the windows of House from the trees and is the first to see that it has entered the forest.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Shevara climbs a beech tree to count House's windows, part of the elves' watch.
timeline.quote: Shevara stood high in one of the ancient, dreaming beech trees, counting windows

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Rotrue elves realize they may be the last living outside House.
timeline.quote: The elves of the Rotrue might well be the last yet living outside the walls of House.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Shevara sees a circle of human children clapping and chanting in the forest, a sign House is near.
timeline.quote: she saw a small circle of human children, five in total

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Shevara tells the king that House is in the forest, but he refuses to believe it.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The king insists the forest is protected, and the other scouts report nothing.
timeline.quote: None of them had seen anything like she reported.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A second circle of children finishes a chant and turns toward Shevara; she runs.
timeline.quote: On the final word, they opened their eyes as one and turned toward Shevara

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Shevara returns to find the king and hunters slumped with moths in their hair.
timeline.quote: the hunters and the king sitting slumped with eyes closed and moths alighting in their hair

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: House grows a glass conservatory around the last free elves.
timeline.quote: House constructed its conservatory, with the last of the elves inside.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Dead End" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2024.
